description: Reference history and as-of, scanned without any trading calendar.
explanation: Without an official calendar, missing weekdays are unverified gaps and special sessions cannot be detected (D28). P-CAL-1 makes G0 MANUAL with CALENDAR_UNVALIDATED, and the most restrictive outcome wins (spec 8), so the zone that is ACTIONABLE with a calendar can only be MANUAL_REVIEW without one.
title: No calendar: the same fresh zone is MANUAL_REVIEW, never ACTIONABLE
